desc.zh-CN: Claude3-Opus 是 Anthropic 出品的第三代 Claude 模型，该系列包含 Haiku, Sonnet 和 Opus 三个模型，其中 Opus 是其中能力最强的模型。Claude3-Opus 与 Claude2 的服务响应速度类似。

desc.zh-CN: DeepSeek-V2 是一个强大的专家混合（MoE）语言模型，其特点是经济的训练和高效的推理。它总共包含 2360 亿个参数，其中每个标记激活了 210 亿个参数。与 DeepSeek 67B 相比，DeepSeek-V2 实现了更强的性能，同时节省了 42.5% 的训练成本，减少了 93.3% 的 KV 缓存，并将最大生成吞吐量提高了 5.76 倍。
desc.en-US: DeepSeek-V2 is a strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model characterized by economical training and efficient inference. It comprises 236B total parameters, of which 21B are activated for each token. Compared with DeepSeek 67B, DeepSeek-V2 achieves stronger performance, and meanwhile saves 42.5% of training costs, reduces the KV cache by 93.3%, and boosts the maximum generation throughput to 5.76 times.

desc.zh-CN: GLM-4 是智谱 AI 出品的 API 模型，参数量超过千亿量级。该模型会进行周期性版本迭代
desc.en-US: GLM-4 is an API model from Zhipu AI, with a parameter count exceeding the hundred billion scale. This model undergoes periodic version iterations.

desc.zh-CN: Qwen1.5 是 Qwen2 的测试版，保持了作为仅解码器的变换模型架构，拥有 SwiGLU 激活函数、 RoPE 和多头注意力机制，拥有九种模型大小，增强了多语言和聊天模型能力，支持 32768 令牌的上下文长度，所有模型均启用了系统提示以实现角色扮演，代码支持 transformers 原生实现。
desc.en-US: Qwen1.5 is the beta version of Qwen2, maintaining its architecture as a decoder-only transformer model with SwiGLU activation, RoPE, and multi-head attention mechanisms. It offers nine model sizes and has enhanced multilingual and chat model capabilities, supporting a context length of 32,768 tokens. All models have enabled system prompts for roleplaying, and the code supports native implementation in transformers.

desc.zh-CN: abab6.5 是由 MiniMax 出品的 API 模型。abab6.5 系列是万亿参数 MoE 大语言模型。abab6.5 适用于复杂场景，例如应用题计算、科学计算等场景，abab6.5s 适用于通用场景
desc.en-US: abab6.5 is an API model produced by MiniMax, with the version number being abab6.5. The abab6.5 serie is a trillion-parameter Mixture of Experts (MoE) large language model. The abab6.5 is suitable for complex scenarios, such as application problem calculations, scientific computations, and other similar scenarios. The abab6.5s is suitable for general scenarios.

desc.zh-CN: Llama3 是 Meta 最新开源的大语言模型，使用 15T 语料进行训练，支持 8K 上下文长度，针对有效性和安全性进行了优化。
desc.en-US: Llama3 is Meta's latest open-source large language model, trained on a 15T corpus, supports an 8K context length, and has been optimized for effectiveness and safety.

desc.zh-CN: Mixtral-8x7B 大型语言模型（LLM）是一个预训练生成式的稀疏专家混合模型。在我们进行的大多数基准测试中，Mistral-8x7B 在性能上优于 Llama 2 70B。

desc.zh-CN: ChatGLM3 是智谱AI和清华大学 KEG 实验室联合发布的新一代对话预训练模型。ChatGLM3-6B 是 ChatGLM3 系列中的开源模型，在保留了前两代模型对话流畅、部署门槛低等众多优秀特性的基础上，ChatGLM3-6B 拥有更强大的基础模型，更完整的功能支持和更全面的开源序列。
desc.en-US: ChatGLM3 is a new generation of pre-trained conversational models jointly released by Zhisp AI and Tsinghua University's KEG Lab. ChatGLM3-6B is the open-source model in the ChatGLM3 series. While retaining the smooth conversation and low deployment threshold of the previous two generations, ChatGLM3-6B boasts a more powerful base model, more complete functional support, and a more comprehensive open-source sequence.
